columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Invoice number, kept as text (identifiers are text; Session D rule). A leading C marks a cancellation invoice; see is_cancellation.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile confirms null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 2330, consistent with required true.

columns.name: is_cancellation
columns.description: True when invoice_id carries the C cancellation prefix. Decision: cancellations are retained and flagged, not dropped, so conservation arithmetic against bronze stays auditable; exclusion is a consumer decision made at the mapping contract, not silently here.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile confirms null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 2, consistent with required true.

columns.name: stock_code
columns.description: Product code as landed, kept as text; alphanumeric suffixes and non-product adjustment codes (for example POST, M) occur.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile confirms null_rate 0.0, consistent with required true.

columns.name: product_description
columns.description: Product description, whitespace-trimmed. Nulls retained rather than imputed.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile shows null_rate 0.005098 (228 nulls), consistent with required false.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Units on the line, cast from DECIMAL(38,9) to INTEGER. Negative values occur both on cancellation-invoice lines and on zero-unit-price stock-adjustment lines; consumers must not infer cancellation from negative quantity alone.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile confirms null_rate 0.0, consistent with required true.

columns.name: invoiced_at
columns.description: Invoice timestamp. Decision: strict cast from the VARCHAR landing ("YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"); an unparseable value fails the build loudly rather than becoming a silent null. On within-invoice clock-drift duplicates the earliest scan tick wins (min).
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile confirms null_rate 0.0, consistent with required true.

columns.name: unit_price
columns.description: Unit price in sterling, cast from DECIMAL(38,9). Observed range 0.00 to 1998.49. Decision: zero-price lines (freebies and adjustments) are retained; negative prices are contract-invalid.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile confirms null_rate 0.0 and range 0.0 to 1998.49, consistent with required true and the non-negative rule.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer identifier, cast DECIMAL(38,9) to INTEGER (integral min, max, and samples, 12346 to 18287). Decision: the bronze null rate is retained as null (guest or unregistered checkouts), not dropped and not imputed.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile shows null_rate 0.300664, consistent with required false.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Customer country as landed (24 distinct values observed).
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile confirms null_rate 0.0, consistent with required true.

columns.name: captured_at
columns.description: Capture timestamp carried forward from the bronze landing (_airbyte_extracted_at): when the surviving line's earliest capture entered the pipeline. Required because the incremental path has landed and every surviving line now carries a capture timestamp; this is the watermark the gold layer builds on.
columns.rationale: Operator intent states the incremental path has landed; fresh profile measures captured_at at null_rate 0.0 over 44721 rows (null_count 0), confirming the follow-up tightening declared at v1.2.0 is now supported by evidence.

purpose: The cleaned, typed, one-row-per-invoice-line view of the Online Retail II sample: the first contracted silver table and the sole silver input to the gold unified event star.
usage: Read silver.silver_invoice_lines for line-level retail sales analysis. Cancellation lines are RETAINED and flagged (is_cancellation); consumers aggregating revenue must filter or net them deliberately. Zero-price lines are retained.
limitations: Exact duplicate bronze rows are treated as capture artifacts and excluded, so identical legitimate re-scans are indistinguishable and also excluded; the residual grain is the distinct line. Rows identical in every business column except invoicedate are the same capture artifact seen across a register clock tick; they collapse to one line and the earliest timestamp is retained. customer_id remains null for guest or unregistered checkouts and those rows are retained with customer_id null.
